output.summary: A large-leaved flowering perennial native to southern Chile and neighboring parts of Argentina and Bolivia, it has huge lobed leaves and spike-covered stems. In Chile, peeled stalks are eaten fresh or cooked into jam or cordial, while the leaves are used to prepare curanto.
output.edibilityNote: In native Chile, peeled stalks are eaten fresh or cooked into jam or cordial; leaves are used to prepare curanto.
